description: Header file defining the BufferQueueConsumer class, which manages buffer consumption in Android's graphics buffer queue system. It declares methods for buffer acquisition, attachment, detachment, release, connection management, and configuration settings.
external_methods: status_t releaseBuffer(int, uint64_t, const sp<Fence>&, EGLDisplay, EGLSyncKHR)
status_t releaseBuffer(int, uint64_t, EGLDisplay, EGLSyncKHR, const sp<Fence>&)

classes.name: BufferQueueConsumer
classes.description: Manages buffer consumption in Android's graphics buffer queue system, providing methods for buffer acquisition, release, connection, and configuration.

methods.name: BufferQueueConsumer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the BufferQueueConsumer with a core buffer queue reference.

methods.name: ~BufferQueueConsumer
methods.description: Destructor for BufferQueueConsumer.

methods.name: acquireBuffer
methods.description: Attempts to acquire ownership of the next pending buffer, returning status and buffer info.

methods.name: detachBuffer
methods.description: Detaches a buffer from a specified slot.

methods.name: attachBuffer
methods.description: Attaches a buffer to a specified slot.

methods.name: releaseBuffer
methods.description: Releases a buffer slot back to the buffer queue, with synchronization fences.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects a consumer to the buffer queue.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the consumer from the buffer queue.

methods.name: getReleasedBuffers
methods.description: Retrieves a mask of buffers that have been released but not yet processed.

methods.name: setDefaultBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the default size for buffers returned by dequeueBuffer.

methods.name: setMaxBufferCount
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of buffers in the queue.

methods.name: setMaxAcquiredBufferCount
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of buffers that can be acquired simultaneously.

methods.name: setConsumerName
methods.description: Sets the name used for logging purposes.

methods.name: setDefaultBufferFormat
methods.description: Sets the default pixel format for buffers.

methods.name: setDefaultBufferDataSpace
methods.description: Sets the default data space for buffers.

methods.name: setConsumerUsageBits
methods.description: Enables additional usage bits for buffer dequeue.

methods.name: setConsumerIsProtected
methods.description: Indicates whether the consumer can handle protected buffers.

methods.name: setTransformHint
methods.description: Provides rotation or transformation hints for buffers.

methods.name: getSidebandStream
methods.description: Retrieves the sideband buffer stream, if any.

methods.name: getOccupancyHistory
methods.description: Gets the occupancy history of buffer slots.

methods.name: discardFreeBuffers
methods.description: Discards free buffers to free resources.

methods.name: dumpState
methods.description: Dumps the internal state of the buffer queue for debugging.

methods.name: releaseBuffer (overloaded)
methods.description: Releases a buffer with EGL synchronization.

methods.name: consumerConnect
methods.description: Connects a consumer with a specified control mode.

methods.name: consumerDisconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the consumer from the buffer queue.

methods.name: setAllowExtraAcquire
methods.description: Configures whether extra buffers can be acquired.
